collectionMethod: Manual capture of the official Command Code GOAT pages (English) around 10:38 Beijing time / 02:38Z on 2026-11-04: the GOAT plan page, the public pricing page and the pricing-limits resource page, read as published, and compared line-by-line against the same three pages captured on 2026-11-03. Both the rendered text diff and the embedded RSC payload diff (budgetUsd / rates / budgetSteps / shape / timeOfDay per model) were checked. Research-only — no adopted row generated, no adopted value changed, no script changed.
scope: Command Code GOAT official pages only. One model status change: 'Ling 3.1 Flash 1019' (model id ling-3.1-flash-1019) ended its limited-time free offer ('free until 16:00 UTC on November 3, up to 100 requests a day') and reappeared on the GOAT plan page as a paid row with 1M context, per-token prices $0.30 input / $0.90 output / $0.06 cached read per 1M tokens and $100 per-model credits, marked 'not yet scored'. The embedded RSC payload for the new paid row carries budgetUsd 100 with no budgetSteps and no timeOfDay. The pricing-limits page gained a matching boosted-credit deal 'ling-3.1-flash-1019-boosted-credits' ($100 GOAT · $110 Pro, 'Rates unchanged · auto-applied when you pick', no end date written). The free 'ling-3.1-flash-1019:free' entry and the 'Free on Ling 3.1 Flash 1019' block on the pricing page disappeared from all three pages. A new free stealth model 'Crouton Alpha' appeared in that place on the pricing page (recorded as not tracked). The GOAT model counters on the plan page moved 71 -> 72 and 97 -> 98. The other 59 previously listed GOAT models keep the same budgetUsd / rates / budgetSteps / shape / timeOfDay, and the shared-pool wording (GOAT 'Up to $100', Pro 'Up to $110') did not change. No leaderboard/score data, no OpenCode Go rows touched, no other channel's rows touched, no adopted.csv row.

previousCapture.note: The 2026-11-03 baseline used here is the same-pages re-capture taken on 2026-11-03 for the 2026-11-04 comparison; it is not stored as a separate research file in this repo. The last stored GOAT capture is data/research/goat-deepseek-glm-boost-round1-2026-10-31.json, which is where the free 'Ling 3.1 Flash 1019' model was first recorded.

computationNote: No monthlyYi, no blended per-MTok price, no effective min() value and no adopted value are computed in this file; all dollar figures, rates and request estimates are transcribed as published on the official pages.
confidenceNote: The status change, the per-token rates, the $100 per-model credits and the request estimates are official and internally consistent across the three captured pages. Confidence is not 'high' because the new boosted-credit deal states no term, so it cannot be told from the pages whether the $100 per-model allowance is permanent or of unstated duration, and the 1019 checkpoint is 'not yet scored'.
